observed_retained_traffic.scope: all retained v1 run_completed events, including pre-fix failures

current_local_dataframe_benchmark.prompt: 현재 보유한 데이터의 `metric_x` 컬럼 히스토그램을 보여줘
current_local_dataframe_benchmark.scope: cold temporary conversations using a bounded persisted-data sample

current_concurrent_local_benchmark.scope: parallel cold conversations using independent copies of the persisted local DataFrame

current_local_correlation_benchmark.prompt: 현재 보유한 데이터의 `metric_x`와 `metric_y`의 피어슨 상관계수를 계산해줘.
current_local_correlation_benchmark.scope: cold temporary conversations using the persisted local DataFrame and a pandas oracle

live_server_memory_snapshot.measurement: single ps RSS snapshot after the verified live journey

interpretation_limits: The sampled asset is re-scoped as benchmark.sample; a bounded prefix is not the complete source population.
Retained traffic includes failures from older code and is a historical baseline, not a current-version SLO claim.
The controlled benchmark covers the deterministic current-DataFrame histogram path only.
The concurrent benchmark uses isolated conversations in one process; it is not a distributed deployment load test.
The server RSS value is one snapshot; instrumented live-turn counts remain too small for a product-wide RSS percentile.
